newsitem.title: USA: Rubin voices concerns about Republican tax bills.
newsitem.headline: Rubin voices concerns about Republican tax bills.

text.p: The Clinton administration has "serious concerns" about Republican-introduced tax bills now being discussed in both the House of Representatives and the Senate, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Wednesday.

"We have very serious concerns about the effects of the two tax bills ... in terms of the distribution of benefits," he told public television's Nightly Business Report. "We feel the benefits need to be fairly balanced ... and that is not true of either of the bills."
He said that neither bill lives up to an earlier agreement between the administration and Congress that the budget provide roughly $35 million in tax breaks for education over five years.
